name: NoveLA
tagline: Read web novels from 25+ sources, even offline
description:
NoveLA is a free novel reader that pulls chapters from more than 25 different novel sites, plus your own EPUB files, all in one app. It has a built-in translator, text-to-speech, and offline reading so you can keep going without a connection.

It's an actively developed alternative to other popular novel readers, aimed at readers who want more sources and fewer limits.
